title: Film braid chart source
description: One film's chart source. films/<slug>.yaml is the authored file; captions are chart captions (two lines), clusters are who stands together in each beat.

score.description: Whole-film rubric score out of 30, or null if not yet taken.

blurb.description: Optional page copy; generated if absent.

legend_object.description: A title object rather than a person, e.g. 'the dresses'.

title_block.description: Full custom title block: [text, style] pairs.

caption_source.description: Where the captions came from, and what could NOT be verified against a source. Keep this honest.

chart_limits.description: What this chart deliberately leaves out (e.g. strands folded into a shared 'others' lane).

storylines.description: Optional per-strand notes on what each lane is following.

never_separate_ok.description: Set with a reason when the leads genuinely never part; exempts the film from the separation rule.

order.description: Lane order. Defaults to the chars order.

width.description: Story weight: lead 30-34, second 22-28, third 16-20, minor 12-15.

loc.description: Approximate position, e.g. '≈ 35-50 min' or 'the coda'.

cap.description: Exactly two caption lines. Lines over ~47 chars are wrapped at render time.

tag.description: What the beat is, after an em dash.

cats.description: Rubric categories this beat's shape belongs to (not points owed).

clusters.description: Left-to-right; each entry is the ids standing together. A character present must appear in exactly one cluster.

groups.description: Hand-tuned alternative to clusters: [lane_y, [ids]] with larger y further right.

stubs.description: Final exit. Must name the character's LAST PRESENT beat.
